use_case_name: Transfer a Winning Order to Another Customer

evidence_cards.content: The page displays a 'No Problem!' pop-up dialog that appears when a user has won items and chosen PayPal or Amazon Payments as default payment method, offering options to 'Return to Payments' or go to 'JTVauctions Homepage'.

source_locations.location: center of page, within the mockup screenshot, specifically the white dialog box titled 'No Problem!'

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This pop-up represents a system state triggered after winning an auction and selecting a payment method — it is not the trigger for transferring an order to another customer. No evidence on this page describes any action or event that initiates the 'Transfer a Winning Order to Another Customer' use case.

evidence_cards.content: The trigger for the 2nd-Chance Auction process is when an auction participant with PayPal or Amazon Payments as their default payment method fails to pay for their winning within 7 days (168 hours) of the auction ending time.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the exact event that initiates the transfer of a winning order to another customer — specifically, non-payment by the original winner within the specified timeframe.

evidence_cards.content: The page displays a 'My Bid History' interface with two tables: 'Items I've Won' and 'Items I Bid On, But Did Not Win', showing item details including Item #, Description, Auction Number, Winning High Bid, Total Bids, Last Bid Time, Ending Time, and Payment Status.

source_locations.location: Main content area below header, starting at 'My Bid History' heading

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This is the entry context for any action related to winning bids; however, no explicit trigger for transferring a winning order to another customer is present on this page.

evidence_cards.content: The use case is triggered when an auction participant who has PayPal or Amazon Payments set as their default Method of Payment fails to pay for their winnings within 7 days (168 hours) of the auction ending time.

source_locations.location: Page 136, Section 11.2 Process, first bullet point

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This explicitly defines the specific event and condition (non-payment by deadline) that initiates the process leading to the transfer of the order to another customer.
